children: H.B. Fuller's adjusted Ebitda margin reached a record 19.9% in the third quarter, up 80 basis points year-on-year. Adjusted EPS climbed 21% to $1.52, driven by higher adjusted net income. Net revenue rose 5.2% to $938 million. CEO Celeste Mastin said the company continues to advance toward its Ebitda margin target of greater than 20%. The company raised its fiscal 2026 adjusted Ebitda guidance to a range of $655 million to $670 million and now expects adjusted EPS of $4.70 to $4.85.
